notes:
Short summary: Lost to self-host. CTO James Lo made decision after security & cost review — wants full control of artifacts/weights, local KMS, and predictable infra spend. InfoSec flagged need for air-gapped option and HSM for signing; we couldn’t commit to air-gap timelines. Procurement paused during Q1 budget freeze. No clear internal champion after lead engineer moved to another project. Customer message: "We appreciate Redwood work but running vLLM + TGI stack with TensorRT-LLM on our cluster gives us latencies within target and far cheaper at scale."

Supporting details (clerical CRM style):
- Use case: operator assist + anomaly reranking across telemetry streams; 10k qps peak for embeddings/rerank, sub-100ms p99 for short chat completions during operator workflow.
- Cost sensitivity: high; 3yr TCO modelling favored self-host for >$100k/month token-like loads.
- Security: absolute requirement for customer-managed KMS, detailed audit trails, storage residency in NA-only.
- POC ask that we couldn't meet quickly: air-gapped private deploy and HSM integration on 6 week timeline.
- Quotes from calls: "If we don't own the keys and the model artifacts, we can't certify for our clients."

Follow-up actions:
- Mark as lost; schedule automated nurture (6 months) to check for pain points after self-host rollout.
- Add to win/loss notes for RD to evaluate possible feature gaps (HSM/KMS offering, air-gap program timeline).
- Keep Priya assigned as SE to remain a technical contact for future re-engagement.
deal_notes_short: Closed-lost: chose self-host (vLLM/TGI/TensorRT-LLM) for control/cost; security + budget blockers; no champion.
win_loss_reason: Customer prioritized full control (keys/artifacts), HSM requirement and lower long-term infra cost with self-host stack. InfoSec timeline mismatch and procurement freeze accelerated decision.
